question: Is the 5.42% token savings margin (1067 tokens) from parameterized deduplication robust to realistic completion token estimation error, or is it fragile and likely an artifact of the assumed 2/15/20 completion token distribution?
hypothesis: The 5.42% margin is fragile: systematic completion token estimation error of less than 1 token/task (32 tasks * 1 token = 32 tokens) erases the margin (1067 tokens). Specifically: (H1) the break-even systematic bias in completion tokens is < 2 tokens/task, (H2) the margin is dominated by the selection prompt savings (112 tokens, 14.16%) not the completion savings, (H3) under realistic completion token variation (±50% of estimates), the margin survives in < 30% of bootstrap samples.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if: (F1) the break-even systematic bias is ≥ 3 tokens/task (> 32 tasks * 3 = 96 tokens, still < 10% of margin), indicating the margin is robust to realistic estimation error, OR (F2) under ±50% completion token variation, the margin survives in > 70% of bootstrap samples. MIXED if the break-even is 1-3 tokens/task and survival rate is 30-70%.

B-TOKEN-ESTIMATES.description: Current analytical estimates: completion tokens 2/15/20 for different task types, total workflow costs LITERAL 19691, PARAMETERIZED 18624, COLD 2475. Carried forward from EXP-PRODUCT-35330741529.
B-TOKEN-ESTIMATES.expected_behavior: Baseline for sensitivity analysis; not re-measured in this experiment

B-SELECTION-PROMPT-ONLY.description: Token savings from selection prompt alone (112 tokens, 14.16%), measured via tiktoken on actual kernel outputs. Isolates the deduplication effect from completion estimates.
B-SELECTION-PROMPT-ONLY.expected_behavior: Selection prompt savings are measured, not estimated; completion savings are estimated

B-COLD-ANALYTICAL.description: COLD baseline at 77.34 tokens/task (prompt-only counting), total 2475 tokens for 32 tasks. Carried forward as reference; COLD success rate unmeasured.
B-COLD-ANALYTICAL.expected_behavior: COLD cost is an upper bound on true cost if success rate < 100%

positive_control.description: Sensitivity analysis on selection prompt savings only (112 tokens): vary completion tokens by ±100% and verify that selection prompt savings remain constant (they don't depend on completion tokens). Validates that the analysis correctly isolates the deduplication effect.
positive_control.expected_behavior: Selection prompt savings remain 112 tokens regardless of completion token variation

null_control.description: Zero-completion-token analysis: set all completion tokens to 0 and recompute savings. The margin should be exactly 112 tokens (selection prompt only), confirming that completion estimates don't affect the measured selection savings.
null_control.expected_behavior: With zero completion tokens, savings = 112 tokens (selection prompt only)

measurement_validity: Token costs from EXP-PRODUCT-35330741529 are carried forward as-is; not re-measured
Completion token estimates (2/15/20) are treated as the central estimate; sensitivity analysis varies them systematically
Break-even analysis computes the systematic bias (delta per task) needed to erase the 1067-token margin
Bootstrap analysis samples completion token variations from a normal distribution centered on estimates with coefficient of variation 0.5 (realistic for LLM output variability)
All analyses are deterministic given the carried-forward token costs; no new measurements or API calls required
Analysis uses the frozen 32-task corpus task composition: 5 blog-read-post (completion=2), 15 shop/admin/pm tasks (completion=15), 12 other tasks (completion=20)
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of: (C1) break-even systematic bias computed and reported, (C2) bootstrap survival rate computed for ±50% completion token variation, (C3) selection prompt savings confirmed constant under completion variation (positive control), (C4) null control (zero completion) yields exactly 112 tokens savings. FALSIFIED if: break-even ≥ 3 tokens/task AND bootstrap survival > 70% (margin robust). MIXED if break-even 1-3 tokens/task AND survival 30-70%. FRAGILE if break-even < 1 token/task OR survival < 30%.
product_consequence_positive: If the margin is ROBUST (break-even ≥ 3 tokens/task AND survival > 70%), this supports continuing toward real LLM measurement (option A from parent handoff) and validates the token-based economics line.
product_consequence_negative: If the margin is FRAGILE (break-even < 1 token/task or survival < 30%), this justifies closing C-PRODUCT-ECON and redirecting product lane to non-token mechanisms (registry compression, retrieval efficiency, correctness improvements).
estimated_cost: Zero: purely analytical sensitivity analysis on carried-forward token costs. No API calls, no HTTP requests, no new measurements. Wall clock < 1 minute.
expected_information_gain: HIGH: This experiment directly resolves the 'thin margin' concern from the parent handoff. Either (a) the margin is fragile and C-PRODUCT-ECON should be closed, or (b) the margin is robust and real LLM measurement should proceed. Either outcome changes a product decision.
